content.text: Waking now and then at 8 is common, especially around a change like back-to-school nerves or a shifting bedtime. One thing to try tonight is a short, calm wind-down. Spend ten minutes at bedtime on a worry chat or a book, with no screens in the last hour. If she wakes at 2am, keep the lights off and walk her back to bed with as few words as you can.
